claims.head: Quality over quantity for the Penguins
claims.call: The Penguins’ average shot has at least their usual 6.7% chance of going in.
claims.body: The Penguins make their shots count, and the Canadiens are one of the league’s worst at preventing dangerous shots. Expect the Penguins to get some real chances.

claims.body: The Canadiens’ penalty kill is near the bottom of the league, and the Penguins’ power play is near the top of the league. Discipline matters more than usual for the Canadiens tonight.

PIT.head: Leaning Pittsburgh’s way
PIT.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and Pittsburgh has home ice. Montréal can still swing it if they get good looks.

MTL.head: Montréal starts a half-step behind
MTL.body: The two have been about even at controlling the play lately and Pittsburgh has home ice. Montréal’s best way to tip it is getting good looks.
